prompt: SOCl2/pyridine converts (R)-2-butanol to the alkyl chloride with INVERSION. Draw the product with correct stereochemistry.

traps.note: SOCl2/pyridine goes with inversion (SN2-like); without pyridine it retains (SNi).

explanation: SOCl2 forms a chlorosulfite R-O-SO-Cl, releasing HCl (scavenged by pyridine). Cl⁻ then displaces the OSOCl group via SN2 → inversion. Without a base, the Cl⁻ stays on the same face (SNi) and the product has retention.
